name: Arcane Battery
body:
Your arcane power can fuel depleted magical items.

Prerequisite(s): One or more of the following (Craft Wand, Craft Staff, Craft Rod, Craft Wondrous Item), Spellcraft 5 ranks, Arcane pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You can expend a point of your arcane pool to replenish a charge of any magic item for which you possess the associated Crafting feat. Replenishing a charge from these items requires a standard action, and expenditure of arcane pool points as follows: a wand for 1 point, a staff or rod for 2 points, a wondrous item for 3 points.
